name: Microfinance and Microlending
summary: Small-scale lending to underserved populations without traditional collateral, formalizing and scaling the mutual-aid principles of rotating credit associations.

claims.statement: Grameen Bank's group lending model achieved 97% repayment rates among borrowers below the poverty line
Microfinance independently emerged from ROSCA-like structures across South Asia, Latin America, and East Africa
Mobile money platforms (M-Pesa) extended microfinance reach to unbanked populations at unprecedented scale

evidence.source: Yunus (1999) Banker to the Poor: Micro-Lending and the Battle Against World Poverty, PublicAffairs
Morduch (1999) The Microfinance Promise, Journal of Economic Literature 37(4)
Armendariz & Morduch (2010) The Economics of Microfinance, 2nd ed., MIT Press
Jack & Suri (2014) Risk Sharing and Transactions Costs: Evidence from Kenya's Mobile Money Revolution, American Economic Review 104(1)

notes: Will fail keystone threshold on longevity (49 years vs 300 required). Important test case: high replication and ethical alignment but too young. Demonstrates that the scoring system correctly filters for durability, not just popularity.
